worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.summary: Throws thick sludge out of the body in one burst: nearby foes are hurt, shoved back and may be poisoned. The curtain has a real height, so low-flying foes are splashed too while high ones are not tracked; it scatters at once and leaves no hazard on the ground. Wide Splash reaches and shoves further; Thick Slap hits harder.
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.use.0: Wash the close ring when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.use.2: Poison the foes pressed against you
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.use.3: Catch low-flying foes in the splash
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.description: When the sludge bursts, at most %2$s foes are hit, each taking about %1$s special damage once. The target's Sp. Def, type and crit are settled on the hit.
The sludge bursts out to %1$s blocks around the body and reaches about %2$s blocks above its centre; low-flying foes are splashed, high ones are not tracked.
Foes actually hurt by the splash have a %1$s chance to be poisoned, and are shoved outward from the centre by %2$s blocks, less when blocked.
It scatters at once: nothing is left on the ground and no hazard field remains, so it cannot seal an area.
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.surge.on: Wide Splash on: ×1.25 radius, a taller curtain and a stronger shove, at about ×0.85 damage, for drenching a ring of close foes at once.
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.surge.off: Wide Splash off (Thick Slap): about ×1.12 damage with the tightest radius, for soaking the foes pressed against you in one go.
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.timing: Cast on the space within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.growth.0: At level %1$s the sludge rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks wide, and the poison chance to %4$s.
On: a wider, taller splash that shoves harder, at about 24%% less damage, for drenching a ring of close foes. Off: one thicker, heavier slap with the tightest radius.
Beyond this distance the companion walks in instead of splashing; higher opens earlier but lets foes step away first.
With this on, the companion raises Sludge Wave when 2 or more foes stand within its own reach, so one splash catches the ring; off keeps the normal attack order.
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.description: Poison lasts about 40 seconds, draining health over time without ever defeating the target, and can be cured; Poison-type, Steel-type and suitably immune targets cannot be poisoned.
